planets.name: TOI-4308 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4308 with a 9.15-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-4308 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-4308. Its orbit and size follow Mistry et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
